main_text.p: עַיִן Ch.& Syr.Oculus: Item Fons,aquas effundens, ut oculus lachrymas: Item Nubes, juxta quosdam, Cant.2.6. ut sic idem sit quod עֵינָא. Plur.עֵינִין Oculi, emph. עֵינֵיהּ: & fœmin. עֵינִין, Fontes, Exod.15.v.ult. in Targ.Jon. Targum Hierosol. habet עֵינִין.
עַיִן־גְּלָא Nomen lapidis pretiosi. Vide in עַל.
Syr.In oculis, In cõspectu, Coràm, Act. 16.37. Matt.27.24. Mar.2.12. Palàm, aperte, publicè, liberè.
מְעַיִן Ch.Ex specie, Ex aspectu, colore, forma alicujus rei,id est,Species, pars, summa, compendium, synopsis, מְעַיִן כָּל פִּתְגָמַיָּא Summa omnium verborum,Josuæ 24.27.
מַעְיְנָא, מַעַיָן Ch.& Syr.Fons. Vide præterea in מעינא.
עַיֵּן Chald. Oculis intueri, inspicere, respicere,videre, considerare, meditari, Genes.3.15. & Deut.33.29. in Targ.Hierosol. Cum Cholem, יְעַיֵּן Respicit, Jobi 8.17.
עִיפָּא Ch. Peplum. Hinc Verbum in Ithpeh. אִתְעִיף Operire,velare se. Præt. fœm. וְאִתְעִיפַת בַּיְתָא Et operiebat se eo, Genes.24.65. in Targ.Jon.
עִיר* Ch. Pullus, ut Hebraicè, Zach.9.9.
עכב Pahel עַכֵּב Ch.Morari,cunctari,tardare,differre. Ithpah. אִתְעַכַּב Idem: & Impediri, tardari, differri, Eccles.3.11. Jesa.40.26.

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic and Syriac words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several vowel-pointed forms and the Syriac line are uncertain. The page is faintly show-through from the reverse side, which was left out.
